name: Popover
propertyCopy: Trigger label, title and body text are properties of the same component, not separate popovers built by hand - change them below to check every placement and content state in the Live Preview.
guide: Component Guide Human View Machine View Overview Popover shows contextual details, a quick action, or a small settings panel next to a trigger element, opened by a click rather than a hover - richer and more persistent than Tooltip, since it stays open until the user dismisses it or clicks elsewhere. When to Use Contextual details revealed on click - more information than a hover-only Tooltip can comfortably hold. An inline help panel or a quick-actions menu - a small floating panel anchored to its trigger. A filter/settings mini-panel or a user-info preview - richer content that benefits from staying open while the user reads or interacts with it. When Not to Use A short, single-line hint - use Tooltip - Popover is heavier than a brief label needs. A yes/no confirmation with Confirm/Cancel actions - use Pop Confirm, which is purpose-built for that exact pattern. Content that should fully block the rest of the page - use Modal or Drawer instead of a lightweight anchored panel. Best Practices Keep the content focused and scoped to what the trigger is about - a Popover shouldn't turn into a secondary page. Close it on outside click and Escape, consistent with other floating-panel components. Anchor it reliably to its trigger even as the page scrolls or resizes, so it never floats disconnected from context. Do and Don't Do Storage almost full92% used. Free up space or upgrade your plan.ⓘ A short title plus one or two lines of real detail - richer than a Tooltip, but still small enough to read at a glance. Don't Account settingsFull profile editing, notification preferences, connected apps, billing history and two-factor setup all live here - update anything and it saves immediately across every device you are signed into.ⓘ A popover this dense is really a page pretending to float. Once it needs paragraphs, send the user to a real settings screen instead. Accessibility The trigger exposes aria-expanded and aria-haspopup, reflecting the popover's open state. Focus moves into the popover when it opens and returns to the trigger when it closes. Interactive content inside it (buttons, links) remains fully keyboard-reachable in a sensible tab order.
